issues.finding: The account says a set first appears immediately after all its elements. At a limit stage there need not be one immediate predecessor containing all member formation stages; only strict later-than-each-member formation is required. The repeated immediately after phrase obscures the contradiction for self-membership.
issues.proposed_resolution: State that every set forms at a stage later than each of its elements; a self-membered set would have to first appear later than its own first-appearance stage, which is impossible.

translation_treatment: Translated separation, its stage justification and consequences; repaired only the imprecise stage-order prose, with formulas unchanged. Two source-language diaereses are normalized in the comparison view.
